scenes.location: Hamack entrance area of the shared underground bar.
scenes.storyState: The party is seeking Joe and information about Lucia; the informant can point them toward the spaceport and Mars.
scenes.purpose: Translate the R02-accessible Hamack section of the shared underground bar, including its rumor lead and conditional responses.
previousContext: The party has entered Hamack and learned that the underground bar may have information.
followingContext: The informant’s paid lead points toward the spaceport and a possible Mars destination.
branchAlternatives: These are separate patrons and alternate responses, not a linear conversation. Entries 020/021/023/024 are parts of conditional information-for-money interaction.
evidence: Fresh source replay and RE-confirmed Hamack door/coordinate partition; 001–012 and 014–024 are direct R02 region.
uncertainty: Zorias/Ulyria and the religious group/leader spellings are provisional; retain Bible spellings when referenced.
The final rumor is hearsay, not verified destination information.
notes: The map is shared by several towns; this packet includes only the Hamack-accessible region.
scenes.reviewNote: Checked each source text token and the reachable Hamack bar region. Preserve the separation of distinct patrons, and keep the spaceport/Mars statement as rumor.
